chapter_title_en: The Three Kings of the Nether
chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Names the Yama Kings: Skeleton Alliance in World of Immortality
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen awakens to find three intelligent skeletons. He names them after the Yama Kings and forms a deadly alliance in the Death Swamp as his pursuers close in.
og_title: Skeleton Kings Rise: Xiao Chen's Deadly Pact
og_description: After the Eight-Armed Malignant Dragon destroys reinforcements, Xiao Chen allies with three cunning skeletons named after the Kings of Hell. The swamp becomes a death trap.
twitter_title: Yama Kings Named: Xiao Chen's Undead Allies
twitter_description: In the Death Swamp, Xiao Chen bonds with three skeletons, naming them after the Yama Kings. A new phase of survival begins.
